text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for lending me that
manga.
The story was simply wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You liked it!? Any parts in particular?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see now... I especially liked
the line, "It
is not enough to be loved.
You must love in
return."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When the heroine resolved to overcome
her
passive nature and fully accept her
own feelings...
That really touched me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wow... You've grown so much,
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That moment she confessed her love has
such
brilliance... And you totally got it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's why I've decided to try the
same right
away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, cool, that's—huh? Try it? W-wait,
what are
you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My dear Ryan... I love you! Truly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whuh?! Um, uh, wooow! Me?! Geez, you
scared
me for a second there!
